name: toolcrib
description: AI-consumable component manifest for React UI toolkit. All units are rem unless noted.

channels.name: theme:changed
channels.payload: { parameters: ThemeParameters; palette: GeneratedPalette; cssVariables: Record<string, string>; }

channels.name: element:resized
channels.payload: { id?: string; target: HTMLElement; width: number; height: number; contentHeight: number }

channels.name: element:intersected
channels.payload: { id?: string; target: HTMLElement; isIntersecting: boolean; ratio: number }

channels.name: popup:shown
channels.payload: { id: string; targetId?: string; data?: any }

channels.name: toast:shown
channels.payload: { id: string; type: SubthemeName; message: string; priority?: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'urgent' }

channels.name: toast:added
channels.payload: { id: string; type: SubthemeName; message: string; priority?: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'urgent' }

channels.name: toast:expired
channels.payload: { id: string; message?: string; type?: string }

channels.name: toast:dismissed
channels.payload: { id: string; message?: string; type?: string; reason?: 'user' | 'expired' | 'action' }

channels.name: toast:action_clicked
channels.payload: { id: string; actionLabel: string; message?: string }

channels.name: error:boundary
channels.payload: { componentName: string; error: string; stack?: string }

channels.name: progress:changed
channels.payload: { id?: string; value: number; max: number }

channels.name: tab:changed
channels.payload: { id?: string; activeId: string; previousId?: string }

channels.name: layout:corners:squared
channels.payload: { domainId: string; slot: 'first' | 'second'; orientation: 'horizontal' | 'vertical'; squaredCorners: { topLeft?: boolean; topRight?: boolean; bottomLeft?: boolean; bottomRight?: boolean; }; }

components.name: Accordion

id.description: Unique identifier for event bus targeting. Auto-generated if omitted.

items.description: Array of items to render as accordion panels.

type.description: `'single'` allows only one panel open at a time. `'multiple'` allows any combination.

defaultValue.description: Value of the initially expanded panel (for `type='single'`).

overrides.description: Per-instance overrides for header padding, item gap, variant, and panel animation.

components.description: Data-driven collapsible panel group with animations

components.name: AlertDialog

id.description: Unique identifier used for event bus targeting (e.g. `aiBus.openAlertDialog('confirm-delete')`). Auto-generated if omitted.

trigger.description: Element that opens the dialog on click. Rendered inline; the dialog manages open/close state automatically.

isOpen.description: Controlled open state. When provided, the component becomes fully controlled.

onOpenChange.description: Callback fired when the dialog opens or closes.

zIndex.description: Z-index layer. Uses the toolkit's Z_INDEX.MODAL tier by default.

ariaLabel.description:
Accessible name announced by screen readers when the dialog opens.
Always visually hidden, matching `Modal`'s `ariaLabel` — set this
explicitly (typically matching your `AlertDialog.Header` text) for a
meaningful announcement.

overrides.description: Per-instance overrides for backdrop blur and overlay darkness.

components.description: Blocking confirmation dialog that cannot be light-dismissed — for destructive/irreversible actions

components.name: AppShell

overrides.description: Per-instance override for Header/Main padding density. Since AppShell is meant to render once, this mostly exists for consistency with other components — the global Theme Editor control is the more typical way to change this.

components.constraints: Intended to be rendered once, at the root of the component tree
components.description: Full-viewport root layout frame with Header and Main slots — the top-level wrapper for an entire app

components.name: Avatar

src.description: Image URL. Falls back to `fallback` if omitted, loading, or failing to load.

alt.description: Accessible alt text for the image.

fallback.description: Content shown while `src` is missing/loading/erroring — typically initials.

fallbackDelayMs.description:
Delay in milliseconds before the fallback renders while the image is
still loading, avoiding a flash of fallback content for a fast-loading
image. Omitted by default — Radix's own `AvatarPrimitive.Fallback`
renders immediately with no artificial delay unless `delayMs` is
explicitly passed (confirmed in `@radix-ui/react-avatar`'s source:
its `canRender` state starts `true` only when `delayMs === undefined`),
so defaulting this to a nonzero value here would force every avatar
with no `src` — the common initials-only case — to sit blank for that
long before showing its fallback, for no benefit.

overrides.description: Per-instance override for the avatar's shape.

components.description: User/entity avatar image with automatic initials fallback

components.name: Button
components.description: Styled button with five variants, three sizes, subtheme colouring, and icon slots

components.name: Card

layout.description:
Layout mode. `'auto'` enables flex filling (height:100%, flex:1) and activates
automatic corner-squaring via layout domain context (e.g. inside a Splitter).

squareCorners.description: Override which corners are squared off. `'auto'` defers to layout domain context.

overrides.description: Per-instance theme overrides (padding, header style, subtheme).

components.description: Slot-based container with automatic layout domain corner squaring

components.name: CardSimple

title.description: Title text rendered in the header. Omit to skip the header entirely.

subtitle.description: Secondary text rendered next to the title in the header.

footer.description: Content rendered in the footer area. Omit to skip the footer.

actions.description: Action elements (e.g. buttons) rendered in the footer's right side.

components.description: Token-saving shorthand for simple cards without slot composition

components.name: Collapsible

id.description: Unique identifier for event bus targeting. Auto-generated if omitted.

trigger.description: Clickable header content that toggles the panel.

isOpen.description: Controlled open state. When provided, the component becomes fully controlled.

onOpenChange.description: Callback fired when the panel opens or closes.

disabled.description: If true, the trigger is non-interactive and the panel can't be toggled.

overrides.description: Per-instance override for header/content padding.

components.description: Single expand/collapse content panel — see Accordion for a data-driven set of panels

components.name: Content

gap.description: Gap between children. Named tokens map to theme spacing scale.

marginMode.description: Override margin/gap using the theme margin token scale.

squareCorners.description:
Explicit corner-squaring override. `<Content>` always establishes a
layout domain (equivalent to `<Card layout="auto">`), so it already
consults the nearest ancestor `<Splitter>`'s layout domain via
`useCornerSquaring` automatically — set this only to override that
with a specific edge instead of deferring to the domain.

components.description: Fills its container and establishes a flex-column layout domain for its children

components.name: ContextMenu

id.description: Unique identifier for event bus targeting. Auto-generated if omitted.

items.description: Array of menu items to render.

overrides.description: Per-instance overrides for shadow depth and item density.

components.description: Right-click action menu, data-driven with separator support

components.name: DataTable

data.description: Array of data records to display.

columns.description: Column definitions controlling header, cell rendering, and sorting.

pageSize.description: Initial number of rows per page.

pageSizeOptions.description: Options shown in the page-size dropdown.

itemHeight.description: Height of each row in pixels (used for virtualization calculations).

containerHeight.description: Container height. `'auto'` fills available space. A number sets a fixed pixel height.

rowKey.description: Custom row key extractor for React reconciliation. Defaults to array index.

overrides.description: Per-instance overrides for density, border style, and striping.

components.description: Virtualized, sortable, paginated data table with sticky headers

trigger.description: Trigger element that opens the menu on click.

components.name: Modal

id.description: Unique identifier used for event bus targeting (e.g. `aiBus.openModal('my-modal')`). Auto-generated if omitted.

trigger.description: Element that opens the modal on click. Rendered inline; the modal manages open/close state automatically.

isOpen.description: Controlled open state. When provided, the component becomes fully controlled.

onOpenChange.description: Callback fired when the modal opens or closes.

width.description: Width of the modal dialog panel.

zIndex.description: Z-index layer. Uses the toolkit's Z_INDEX.MODAL tier by default.

ariaLabel.description:
Accessible name announced by screen readers when the dialog opens.
Always visually hidden — unlike `<SlideOut title>`, which is a visible
`ReactNode` header, this is a screen-reader-only string. `Modal.Header`'s
visible text is decorative only and is not otherwise wired to the
dialog's accessible name, so set this explicitly (typically matching
your `Modal.Header` text) for a meaningful announcement.

overrides.description: Per-instance overrides for backdrop blur and overlay darkness.

components.description: Dialog overlay with focus trap, backdrop, and slot composition

components.name: Splitter

id.description: Unique domain identifier for layout context. Auto-generated if omitted.

orientation.description: Split direction. `'vertical'` = top/bottom panels, `'horizontal'` = left/right panels.

initialSplit.description: Initial percentage allocated to the first (top/left) panel.

components.name: TabStrip

groupId.description:
The `id` of the `<TabStrip>` group this panel belongs to — must match
that TabStrip's own `id` exactly. This is the *only* link between them;
they don't need to share a DOM ancestor. Rendering this panel without
its matching TabStrip mounted anywhere is valid — it just never
receives a `tab:changed` event, so it stays hidden.

value.description: The tab id (matching one of that TabStrip's `items`) this panel renders for.

id.description:
Identifies this tab group for event bus coordination — every
`<TabStrip.Panel groupId={...}>` that should respond to this control
must use the exact same string. Required (not auto-generated) because,
unlike a Modal's `id`, it has to be a stable value the panels — wherever
they're rendered — can reference independently.

items.description: Array of tab definitions to render.

activeId.description:
Controlled active tab id. Omit to let `<TabStrip>` manage its own
state internally — the common case, since panels never need it passed
down (they get it from the bus).

onChange.description:
Change callback for controlled usage (e.g. syncing with a router).
Cross-tree panels should not rely on this — they subscribe to
`tab:changed` via `useAIEvent` instead, which fires regardless of
whether this component is controlled or self-managed.

overrides.description: Per-instance overrides for variant, size, active-tab colour, and panel transition.

components.description: Scrollable tab header with filmstrip overflow. Use TabStrip.Panel for content

components.name: ThemeEditor

options.description: Data-driven options rendered as connected buttons.

disabled.description: If true, every option is disabled.

components.description: Connected button set for single or multiple selection, data-driven
